You are a fix worker on the OBE podcast repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast - edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, branch, or push; leave changes uncommitted. Do not load skills or call MCP/Apps. No network. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for python. Fail closed on REAL defects, but a gate/matcher must never manufacture false failures for legitimate episodes - that is the defect class you are fixing.

FIX the adversarial-review findings in the auto-arm module (Phase 1 lane). All findings confirmed against this tree:

OWNERSHIP: you own ONLY server/pipeline/recording_arm.py, scripts/auto-arm-cron.sh, tests/test_recording_arm.py. Never modify anything else.

FINDINGS:
1. HIGH recording_arm.py:106 - one-token subset fallback can arm an unrelated episode sharing a first name. Fix: candidate match requires EITHER all guest-name tokens (len>=2) present in the event title/guest field OR an exact episode-id/slug reference in the event; single-token overlap is never sufficient; when only weak overlap exists -> not a candidate (and if that leaves zero candidates with an upcoming event, that is an escalation, not a guess). Additionally require event-time plausibility: the episode's booked recording datetime (episode.json recording fields when present) must match the event start within 2 hours, else not a candidate.
2. HIGH recording_arm.py:303 - stale detection ignores completion when stage=='error'. Fix: a room armed to an episode counts as stale when THAT episode has a completed-recording receipt/timestamp OR a terminal/processing/error stage after its recording time - the room must free for the next guest even when the prior episode is in error/review.
3. HIGH recording_arm.py:346 - conflicts grouped by (room, calendar-date) instead of room-across-lead-window; two same-room recordings on consecutive dates within lead_hours produce two arms with the later one winning early. Fix: group by room across the whole lead window; when multiple events for one room fall in the window, arm ONLY the earliest not-yet-recorded one; later ones become deferred entries in the plan (armed after the earlier completes - i.e., they are NOT actions this run), never simultaneous POSTs.
4. HIGH recording_arm.py:589 - dry_run checked after build_arm_plan already queued escalations/notifications. Fix: dry_run must be FULLY side-effect free - no review-queue writes, no notifications, no API calls; plan/escalations are returned in the result only. Restructure so build_arm_plan is pure (returns escalation DESCRIPTIONS) and run_auto_arm performs queue writes/notifications only when not dry_run.
5. MED scripts/auto-arm-cron.sh:12 - always sends CRON_AUTH_TOKEN while the endpoint prefers RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN when both are configured. Fix: use RECORDING_ADMIN_TOKEN when set in the env file, else CRON_AUTH_TOKEN (mirror server/config.py:162 precedence). Never echo the value.
6. MED recording_arm.py:247 - escalations store the episodes ROOT as episode_dir. Fix: store the specific episode's dir when the escalation concerns one episode; for zero-candidate/multi-candidate cases store the room+event context and omit/null episode_dir per the runcard consumer's accepted shape (read server/pipeline/runcard.py and match it exactly).

TESTS: update/extend tests/test_recording_arm.py to cover every fix: single-token collision rejected; time-implausible event rejected; error-stage episode frees the room; consecutive-day same-room window -> one arm + one deferred; dry_run writes nothing (assert queue file absent + notifier monkeypatch never called); token precedence in the shell script (grep test acceptable); escalation shape matches runcard consumer.

HOW TO RUN: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_recording_arm.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

OUTPUT CONTRACT: uncommitted changes + ./fix-summary.md ('# Fix Summary','## Summary','## Files Changed','## Verification','## Assumptions', <600 words).
